items.title: Add deterministic greeting API
items.goal: Add a small public greeting function while preserving existing normalization behavior.

acceptance.text: reference_app.service.greet("  Ada   Lovelace " ) returns "Hello, Ada Lovelace!".
greet rejects a blank or whitespace-only name with ValueError.

non_goals: CI, verification-probe, baseline-test, or authority-document changes.
